About Our Brand and Products:

Pillow4Pain was created by Dr. Georgiy Brusovanik, a spine and joint specialist focused on helping patients find non-invasive relief for chronic pain. Our flagship product is a medically inspired ergonomic support pillow designed to improve joint alignment, reduce pressure, and promote recovery — especially for elbow, back, and posture-related discomfort.

Unlike generic cushions, Pillow4Pain is built around clinical principles used in orthopedic care. It’s designed for people who want a practical, at-home solution to everyday joint strain from desk work, driving, sports, or repetitive use.

What Makes Us Different:

• Developed by a physician with real-world patient experience
• Designed for joint alignment, not just comfort
• Targets elbow and posture-related pain specifically
• Premium materials built for long-term support
• Backed by a satisfaction guarantee
• Focused on prevention and recovery — not temporary masking

We don’t sell a “pillow.” We provide a structured support solution inspired by medical practice.

How Affiliates Can Earn:

• Competitive commission per sale
• Performance bonuses for high-volume partners
• Exclusive promo codes for your audience
• Limited-time campaign boosts during promotions
• Access to product bundles and special offers to increase AOV

With a $79 price point, affiliates benefit from a strong average order value while promoting a product with real problem-solving appeal.

How to Promote Us:

Affiliates see the best results when focusing on:

• Problem-first content (tennis elbow, desk pain, repetitive strain)
• Demonstration videos showing real usage
• Before-and-after comfort comparisons
• Testimonials or personal experience reviews
• Educational content about joint alignment and recovery
• TikTok Shop demos and short-form video hooks
• Blog posts targeting high-intent keywords like “elbow pain relief at home”

Authentic demonstration performs better than polished ads.

Other Information:

• Ships nationwide
• 60-day satisfaction guarantee
• Ideal audience: desk workers, athletes, drivers, parents, and anyone with repetitive strain discomfort
• Works well in bundle offers and limited-time promotions
• Media opportunities available upon request

We’re looking to partner with creators and affiliates who want to promote a practical, high-conversion solution in the health and wellness space.
